lines.speaker: pilot
lines.text: Anvil Yard, this is the courier requesting a berth.

lines.speaker: bureaucrat
lines.text: Request received. Berth four is available, assuming nobody has parked an ore barge in it since I checked.

lines.speaker: bureaucrat
lines.text: Before landing: keep clear of the slag chutes, the freight magnets and anything marked 'temporary'. Temporary equipment here predates me.

lines.speaker: bureaucrat
lines.text: Officially? Refining, fabrication and export. Unofficially? Ore goes in, paperwork comes out, and somewhere in the middle we produce alloy.

lines.speaker: bureaucrat
lines.text: There is always work. Welders, drillers, technicians. Check the contract board and sign the liability waiver before anybody hands you a tool.

lines.speaker: bureaucrat
lines.text: You will need to be more specific. I have six registered grinding noises and three pending complaints about unregistered ones.

lines.speaker: bureaucrat
lines.text: Berth four. Follow the painted line, ignore the unpainted line, and welcome to Anvil Yard.

options.line: What actually comes out of this place?
What is that awful grinding noise?
